description: This is the entry point of a React application, responsible for rendering the main App component into the DOM. It initializes React rendering within the element with ID 'root' and wraps the App component with React.StrictMode for highlighting potential issues.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root container for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot().render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the specified root container.
